newsitem.title: USA: NYH gasoline diffs fail to respond to Bayway rumor.
newsitem.headline: NYH gasoline diffs fail to respond to Bayway rumor.

text.p: New York Harbor cash gasoline differentials showed little movement Tuesday morning despite a quick upward pop in futures markets on rumors of problems at Tosco's Bayway refinery in Linden, New Jersey.

Traders mulled market rumors Tosco's 250,000 barrel per day Bayway refinery was aggressively buying "M2" regular conventional unleaded as well as "V2" premium conventional 93-octane and reformulated "D2" 93-octane.

But differentials on most NYH gasoline grades were stable, with prompt conventional M2 barrels actually talked about 0.25 cent weaker with offers at about 2.60 cents under the May NYMEX screen, traders said.
USG diffs were little changed during early action, with many players absent for an industry outing, according to traders.

One active East Coast trader insisted the rumors were "unfounded," adding, "Bayway is always buying a little bit of this and a little bit of that and I don't see them buying anything more than normal today."
"In fact, they're selling pretty good quantities of 'A2' (regular) reformulated," he added.
